rulings.question: Does "1 of your Digimon gains ＜Rush＞ for the turn and may attack a player" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect activate if not DNA digivolving?

rulings.answer: Because [BT16-077 Dinobeemon] is already using [BT16-091 Beastly Storm Dance of Affection]'s effect to attack, a played Digimon can gain ＜Rush＞, but it can't use this card's effect to attack.
rulings.question: I used [BT16-091 Beastly Storm Dance of Affection]'s effect to DNA digivolve into this card, then I used [BT16-091 Beastly Storm Dance of Affection]'s effect to attack. At such times, can a Digimon played using this card's [When Digivolving] effect gain ＜Rush＞ and attack?

Does the [When Attacking] effect of this card [End of Your Turn] activate "Until the end of Your Turn, one of your Digimon gains "Quick Attack" and can attack a player with that Digimon" even if it has not been digivolved?

rulings.answer: Since "BT16-077 Dinobymon" is attacking under the effect of "BT16-091 Jiayoi no Beast Body Storm Dance," the Digimon played can gain "Quick Attack," but cannot attack under the effect of this card.
rulings.question: I digivolved DNA digivolved to this card under the effect of "BT16-091 Compassionate Beast Body Storm Dance" and attacked it under the effect of "BT16-091 Compassionate Beast Body Storm Dance". At this time, can the Digimon played by this card's [When Attivolving] effect get "Quick Attack" and attack?

rulings.answer: No, it cannot. Digimon that are given "Quick Attack" by this effect will attack as much as possible.
rulings.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to give a Digimon of mine a "Quick Attack" and then not attack with that Digimon?
